subject: Asterion-14B intake — provisional version pin & tokenizer compatibility check
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Asterion-14B intake — provisional pin & tokenizer compatibility check

Hi team,

We have an inbound trial with Nebula Systems starting in early July and they want to standardize on Asterion-14B for the baseline edge workload. Legal has marked the contract as contingent on a stable model interface for the trial window. Product would like to request a provisional version pin for Asterion-14B (v2026-06-15) during the 6-week pilot so we can guarantee repeatable behavior for telemetry and evaluation.

Two asks to start:
- Can Engineering validate tokenizer parity with our production tokenizers (especially the special-whitespace normalization)?
- Is there a short compatibility test we can run against our quantized inference path to rule out embedding drift?

I've attached the intake checklist and a summary of the pilot requirements. If we can get a provisional pin + a small canary plan, Legal & Sales can sign off and push the trial live.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Product Manager, Model Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: asterion-intake-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Asterion-14B intake — provisional pin & tokenizer compatibility check

Laura — copying our current findings from the quick smoke I ran this morning. Quoting your note below.

On Mon, 22 Jun 2026 at 09:12, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We have an inbound trial with Nebula Systems starting in early July ...

Summary (quick tech check):
- Tokenizer: Asterion's tokenizer uses a different normalization step for nonbreaking spaces. That introduces a 0.3% tokenization delta on our standard corpus (not huge but noticeable for prompt alignment).
- Quantization path: The 4-bit quantized variant shipped by the model repo changes the scale handling for attention kernels; on a synthetic parity test we saw embedding cosine drift of ~0.7% at 512 tokens.
- Latency/throughput: nominal on our staging infra but KV cache warmup behaves differently; we should run a 24h continuous workload to observe tail latency.

Proposed immediate plan (see attached): compatibility-test-plan.csv
1) Tokenizer normalization shim in staging + roundtrip check against our tokenizers (1 day).
2) Long-running 24h quantized-run in sandbox (2 days).
3) Telemetry gating: if drift <=1.0% and tail latency delta <=10% we greenlight provisional pin for pilot.

If Engineering and Ops agree, I can run the compatibility runs this week. I also recommend including Soojin for tokenizer parity because she owns the tokenization infra.

- Priyom
Senior Applied ML Engineer

Attachments: compatibility-test-plan.csv (csv)

Hey Laura / Karthik —

Thanks for the heads up. Our engineering org is fine with a provisional pin+telemetry gating approach as long as the pinned version is documented and we get a clear rollback path. Our legal team (contracts@nebula-sys.com) will also need confirmation that telemetry for the pilot can be scoped to the trial workspace and will not be exported outside the US region.

Timeline is tight for us — pilot start target is 2026-07-06. If you need additional test data or sample prompts we can share them today.

Regards,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Asterion-14B intake — provisional pin & tokenizer compatibility check

Thanks Priyom — good checklist.

Internal asks from me before I can approve a provisional pin:
- Soojin: please prioritize the tokenizer parity shim test and post the roundtrip report to INF-4221. If parity is >99.7% we can proceed to quantized runs.
- Priyom / Ops: coordinate a 24h quantized-run in sandbox (use a traffic replay derived from Nebula prompts). Include KV warmup measurement and tail-latency percentile histograms.
- Legal / Sales: Laura, confirm the telemetry residency constraint (US-only) and get a ride-along from Contracts on any additional requirements.

I'll hold the provisional pin decision pending the above results but am willing to sign off fast if the gating thresholds are met. Please treat this as high priority — pilot kickoff is two weeks.

Karthik
Director, Model Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: FINAL: provisional pin approved with gating conditions for Asterion-14B (v2026-06-15)

Folks —

Decision: provisional pin APPROVED for Asterion-14B (v2026-06-15) for the Nebula Systems pilot with the following mandatory conditions:

1) Tokenizer parity shim validated: Soojin to post roundtrip report to INF-4221 and confirm parity >=99.7%.
2) Quantized 24h run in sandbox completed by Priyom with embedding drift <=1.0% and tail P99 latency delta <=10% against baseline.
3) Telemetry scoping: Laura to confirm Contracts sign-off that telemetry is US-only and collected only for the pilot workspace. Contracts must add a clause referencing HubSpot:HS-D-1187.
4) Runbook published: attach provisional-pin-runbook.md and run the first canary (5% traffic) for 24h before scaling.

I authorize the Platform team to create the provisional pin and update our model catalog with a 'provisional' flag. If any gating condition fails, the pin will be revoked and we'll fallback to the prior stable variant.

Next actions (owners):
- Soojin: tokenizer shim + report (due: 2026-06-25 18:00 PDT).
- Priyom: 24h quantized run + metrics (due: 2026-06-26 12:00 PDT).
- Laura: get Contracts confirmation and notify Nebula (due: 2026-06-25 12:00 PDT).

I'll check in on Friday to confirm go/no-go. Thanks everyone for moving quickly.

Karthik
Director, Model Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: provisional-pin-runbook.md (md)
